definitions.explanation: Deliberately unpleasant or hostile actions intended to annoy, intimidate, or torment someone. Covers a range from petty spite and passive-aggressive behavior to serious workplace harassment.

examples.japanese: {嫌|いや}がらせはやめて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{嫌|いや}がらせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧。
examples.english: I am troubled by harassment at work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣人|りんじん}→隣人：10007_rinjin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{嫌|いや}がらせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けていた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧ようやく⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I had been receiving harassment from my neighbor, but it finally stopped after I consulted the police.

notes:
Derived from the verb ⟦{嫌|いや}がる→嫌がる：03041_iyagaru⟧ (to dislike, to be reluctant) with the causative nuance of making someone feel unpleasant.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嫌|いや}がらせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive harassment
- {嫌|いや}がらせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to harass
- {嫌|いや}がらせ⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧: acts of harassment
- {嫌|いや}がらせ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧: harassing phone calls
- {嫌|いや}がらせ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧: harassing emails/messages

USAGE:
Broader than English "harassment" — it covers everything from a child's petty teasing to serious workplace intimidation. In workplace contexts, it overlaps with ⟦パワハラ→パワハラ：05904_pawahara⟧ (power harassment) and ⟦セクハラ→セクハラ：05905_sekuhara⟧ (sexual harassment), though {嫌|いや}がらせ is the native Japanese term and applies to any form of deliberate hostility.
